formulas.description: Click-through rate for a manual log entry or A/B variant.
formulas.name: ctr

formulas.appliesWhen: converting between script word count and spoken duration
formulas.description: Relates spoken script length to recording duration. The 150 wpm default is a narration convention, not a YouTube rule; users must be able to adjust it.
formulas.formula: duration_minutes = words / wpm; words_needed = duration_minutes * wpm
formulas.name: script-length-words-minutes

formulas.description: Word budget for a Shorts script: a 45s short at 150wpm needs ~112 words. Shorts hard limit is 3 minutes (verified platform rule).
formulas.name: shorts-word-budget

formulas.description: Verified YouTube Partner Program thresholds (2026, secondary sources; YouTube Help is the primary source). Long-form watch hours and Shorts views live in separate buckets — they do not combine. The planner computes pace, not eligibility guarantees (rolling windows, review).
formulas.formula: remaining = threshold - current; days_at_current_pace = remaining / daily_rate; required_daily_rate = remaining / target_days

inputs.current: watch hours (long-form path) or Shorts views (shorts path)

formulas.name: ypp-watch-time-pace

formulas.description: Plain linear goal-date projection. Must be labeled 'projection, not promise' — growth is not linear.
formulas.formula: days = ceil((target - current) / rate_per_day); date = today + days
formulas.name: goal-date-projection

formulas.description: Standard WCAG 2.1 relative-luminance contrast ratio. Used to check thumbnail text legibility against its background.
formulas.name: wcag-contrast-ratio

formulas.description: Heuristic duration guidance bands. Compiled from third-party retention benchmarks (Retention Rabbit 2025 via openmontage skill docs; Think Media / Paddy Galloway practitioner data). YouTube publishes no official 'ideal length'. MUST be presented as estimate with source attribution.
formulas.formula: bands: quick-answer (2-5 min) | standard tutorial/review (8-15 min) | deep-dive/essay (15-25 min) | vlog (8-12 min) | Shorts (<=180s, aim <60s)
formulas.name: video-length-sweet-spot

formulas.description: Splits a gear budget across categories by percentage preset. No product prices are invented — categories only.
formulas.name: budget-split

formulas.description: Channel membership revenue math. 70% creator share reported by secondary source (agricidaniel/youtuber wiki, citing YouTube Shopping/Supers pages); mark as such. Member counts are user estimates.
formulas.name: membership-revenue
